title: ICT(Information and Communication Technology)를 활용한 프로젝트 중심 학습(Project-Based Learning)에 대한 교사들의 인식도 연구 - Q 방법 적용 -

abstracts.value: Today's big issue in the field of education is how to apply ICT(Information & Communication Technology) effectively and efficiently in the education. Three years passed since the new curriculum has been put into practice. In spite of advantages with the ICT, problems are come out and not easily solved out. Most of all, the main reason why the education using ICT has not completely settled down is found in the teachers' prefernces of using ICT in the class, so this study focuses mainly on the teachers' perspectives. It introduces the alternative instruction, based on PBL, the projected-based learning, with the ICT appliance. PBL or project-based learning is the instruction to encourage independent student learning of various topics and disciplines. PBL converges especially on the students' high-order thinking and collaboration work using the students' problem solving skills. This study is to find out the teachers' recognition and presume whether the alternative instruction, the project-based learning with ICT, can be put into practice in the present educational system. Through the analysis of the research with the q-methodology, some obstacles when accepting the new instruction in the present educational system, are pointed out. However, as most of teachers in this survey, except two of all the others, have positive attitudes, we can almost make sure of high possibility to accept PBL instruction using ICT in the present educational system.
